title: QQQ: short the return to supply

truth.why: Price fell hard away from the 57.73-57.81 base, so supply exceeded demand there; the gap-up rally back into it is a buyer buying after a rally into supply. Sell the proximal line, buy stop above the distal line, cover just above the demand base for roughly 6:1.

title: USDCHF: sell supply in a downtrend

truth.why: Both trends are down, so only supply is traded; this short base saw a fast drop and a long run to 0.8660 before returning. The buyer on the rally back makes three mistakes (after a rally, into supply, in a downtrend): about 25 ticks of risk for 100+ ticks.

Price left the supply quickly (quality), and the rally beneath it had no basing, so no buy orders sit there to stop a fall (margin). Sell the supply and take profits just above the demand that launched the rally: risk $400 to make $1,200.

title: S&P daily: buy demand into bad news

truth.why: The March 2011 sell-off on Japan news collapsed into a fresh daily demand zone with a clear profit margin up to the prior high. Quality level plus margin means buy, regardless of the headlines and the short-term downtrend.
